input.tokenBudgetScope: all frozen train/dev inputs x A-D, plus 50 diagnostic x A-D and repair stress fixtures
input.newLabels: not created in step4; each future label must pass full assistant/EOS sequence <=5120 and completion <=512 before use
input.testBudget: only isolated fixed-policy entry after final candidate freeze; no test input for A-D tuning

generation.stop: first fixed EOS or max_new_tokens; length stop is truncated failure even if JSON looks complete
generation.effectiveConfig: persist and check every effective parameter before requests; base generation_config sampling defaults must be overridden

historicalFactsOnly.role: historical reference only; not input-equivalent to A-D

baselines.loraComparison: same frozen B2 prompt/plan/rules/input/quantization/decoding; only adapter differs

diagnostics.coverageLimitation: Input-only inventory before any output found exactly 1 factor-conflict train row and 0 dev rows; include the real train row, disclose absent dev coverage. Never fabricate dev coverage or draw from test. Failed r1 retained.
diagnostics.selection: mandatory reviewed dev; rare deficient categories first; missing matches; fill by new match then stable sha256(seed,sampleId); no output/label-text selection
diagnostics.humanEvaluation: all 50 actual model outputs require fresh blind review in step5; additional 23 dev pending; original 7 reported separately

synthesis: 合理联系依据并解释意义
uncertainty: 指明缺失条件及其影响

metrics.denominator: every scheduled original request, including empty/timeout/OOM/truncated/error; B0 separate; retries never add/remove denominator
metrics.rawLegal: runtime completed with EOS AND strict single JSON (no duplicate keys/NaN) AND Narrative Schema AND existing field/content constraints; raw text preserved
metrics.factFaithful: repaired-or-original output must be legal, supported, noncontradictory and free of unsupported new facts; parse/runtime failures are not faithful; unresolved semantic review blocks selection
metrics.errorUnion: sample-level union of unknownEvidenceId OR factualContradiction OR unsupportedNewFact; report union and each component; failures additionally counted in faithfulness denominator

intervals.proportions: Wilson 95%, show numerator/denominator; descriptive only for correlated small sample
intervals.pairedDifferences: point percentage-point difference plus match-cluster paired bootstrap 10000 draws seed42, train/dev separate; no significance claim

B2.exclude: forbidden content or major factual contradiction; unresolved review disallows selection
tieBreak: simpler fixed order A B C D

mainComparison.ceilingProblem: record before opening test; do not lower gate or replace B2 with weaker baseline

finalTest.scope: all rows of frozen 8-match test partition for automatic checks; only original 7 approved paired test scenes for human review
finalTest.history: observed in earlier rule acceptance/human review; not external blind test
finalTest.failure: retain report and template fallback; never choose another adapter or retune on test

recovery.eligibleInfrastructure: process/host interruption before durable terminal result; after dispatch with unknown outcome record indeterminate failure in denominator, do not silently retry
recovery.resume: only not-dispatched IDs; recheck all hashes, preserve prior partial output/logs
recovery.sourceOrConfigDrift: new run and new frozen protocol; never overwrite existing outputs

resources.expectedTime: unknown until step5 calibration; hard ceiling is not throughput estimate
resources.vramAndLatency: not measured by step4 tokenization; no old 2560 evidence substituted
resources.training: no optimizer calls authorized by protocol alone

metamorphic.status: recipe frozen; generated outputs pending step5/6

cases.change: change one living player only through a legal synthetic Scene, recompute team totals/Facts/evidence with frozen analyzer; preserve unrelated phase
cases.expected: correct new count and number comparison; no invented location or future result

cases.change: legal carried -> planted paired synthetic Scene/Facts, update carrier/site and time unknown coherently via frozen builder/analyzer
cases.expected: acknowledge post-plant objective; no invented remaining explosion/defuse time

execution.protocolReadyRequires: complete immutable selection/config/rules/schema/code/tokenizer/source bindings and all budget checks
